name: List All Properties Photos
description: Returns all properties' photos that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filters for property photos. All GET requests must include a filter for [PropertyId].

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the photo

responseFields.name: data[].Position
responseFields.description: The position of the photo in the property photo gallery. If multiple photos are associated with a property, the order of the remaining photos (positions 1 and above) will not change automatically if some photos are deleted.

responseFields.name: data[].Url
responseFields.description: The public link to the photo

responseFields.name: data[].ContentType
responseFields.description: The content type of the photo

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
